description: Get a comprehensive listing of the current 3MF model structure (build items and resources). Enhanced in 024-mcp-agent-ux to include arguments, output_type, and snippet_preview for each implicit function resource.

arguments.description: Function input arguments in set_function_snippet format. Each entry has 'name' (string) and 'type' ('float' | 'vec3').

output_type.description: Output type of the first connected output port

snippet_preview.description: First 3 lines of the function's snippet, or the full snippet if shorter. Useful for quick inspection without calling get_function_snippet.

example.snippet_preview:
float r = length(pos);
return r - radius;
